EILEEN_FLESH_REBIRTH_POWER.title: Meat Gear: Rebirth
EILEEN_FLESH_REBIRTH_POWER.description: Fallen followers deal Stagger damage to Eileen. Phase changes replenish followers and restore survivors; an empty field is replenished.
EILEEN_FLESH_REBIRTH_POWER.smartDescript:
On a phase change, summon a [gold]Church of Gears Follower[/gold] for each follower that died during the phase. Each follower death deals [blue]{ChaoDamage}[/blue] Stagger damage to Eileen. Surviving followers [green]recover all HP and Stagger Resist[/green] on a phase change.
At round start, if no followers remain and Eileen did not become [gold]Staggered[/gold] during the previous round, summon [blue]{Refill}[/blue] followers and use the normal action pattern that round. At most [blue]{Maximum}[/blue] followers can be alive.
